shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): use fixed timestamp in acceptance test for deterministic behavior

The test was using new Date().toISOString() which made it non-repeatable,
triggering the re-lint/no-nondeterministic-tests rule. Replaced with a
fixed ISO timestamp since the actual time value is not relevant to testing
the onError behavior.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
